subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should OpenClaw change unconfigured memory search from watcher/search/session-start only to a default non-zero periodic fallback for stale watcher coverage?
rationale: The bug is source-provable, but the likely fix changes default fallback behavior and may add background scanning/indexing work for existing users, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Adopt refreshed fallback PR
options.body: Resolve conflicts and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90019 with explicit maintainer acceptance of the 30-minute default and the dirty-rescan behavior.

options.title: Keep interval opt-in
options.body: Preserve `intervalMinutes: 0` as the default and close the product direction around docs, diagnostics, or explicit user opt-in instead.

options.title: Use watcher health diagnostics
options.body: Avoid a default behavior change and instead add warning/doctor/runtime health checks for missed watcher coverage.

recommendation.title: Adopt refreshed fallback PR
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90019 with explicit maintainer acceptance of the 30-minute default and the dirty-rescan behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently carried adjacent memory freshness work through merged tests and issue closure, making them the best available routing candidate for the default/freshness decision.
